about.tagline: Discover the passion that drives us.
about.title: About us
about.heading: Our story and mission
about.lead: In a world where the human footprint often blurs nature, Oasis Climb was born with a clear mission: to preserve and share the legacy of the mountains.
about.body: We believe every route, every summit, every via ferrata is a story etched into the landscape, a challenge overcome and a treasure to protect. Our goal is to build a community where technical knowledge and safety come first.
about.quote: “The mountain is an echo of eternity.”
